description: This file contains the code-behind logic for the Leaderboard page of an online examination system. It handles user session validation, retrieves user semester information from the database, and manages page navigation via button click events.

classes.name: Leaderboard
classes.description: The code-behind class for the Leaderboard page, managing user session validation, data retrieval, and navigation.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Event handler for page load. Checks user session, retrieves the user's semester info from database, or redirects to login if not logged in.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Event handler for the home button; navigates to the dashboard page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Event handler for the profile button; navigates to the user profile page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Empty event handler for the leaderboard button; currently does nothing.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Event handler for the logout button; clears user session and redirects to login page.
